title: Today's Top Hits
description: Check out the most popular current hits.

title: Hip Hop Heavyweights!
description: Check out some of the biggest players in Hip Hop...it's MTV Music's Hip Hop Heavyweights!

title: The Christmas Lottery
description: A man who wins the lottery tries to bring his estranged daughters together for Christmas. When his wife loses the ticket, the family members put aside their differences to help find the ticket and in doing so, finally learn to come together.

title: A Christmas Surprise
description: A woman gets a Christmas surprise when her daughter announces her engagement. The holiday soon turns sour as she has to deal with her less-than-impressive and soon-to-be son-in-law, his overbearing mother and an impending wedding.

title: Merry Switchmas
description: Identical twin sisters decide to swap places for the night during their parents' annual Christmas party, where their boyfriends, a feisty great-aunt, and more are in attendance.

title: Christmas Party Crashers
description: When two grifters meet after crashing the same millionaire's Christmas party, they agree to work together, not knowing that they will find something more important than money or fame -- true love.

title: Juwanna Mann
description: Banned from the NBA, a basketball player (Miguel A. Núñez Jr.) dresses in drag in order to play in a woman's league.

title: The Jenkins Family Christmas
description: After burying their father earlier in the year, two sisters attempts to carry on his Christmas traditions without strangling each other. When an unknown half-sister arrives at the family festivities, more than just Christmas presents are exchanged.

title: The Christmas Clapback
description: Every year, three sisters battle each other for a chance to win the Christmas cook-off competition. However, when a vivacious social media influencer enters the competition, the sisters must choose to rise together — or fall divided.

title: A Christmas Gift
description: In a failed attempt to cancel Christmas, the McKenzies find themselves navigating a season filled with unexpected guests, secrets and revelations that will have a lasting effect on their lives.

title: A Miracle Before Christmas
description: A workaholic relationship counselor rethinks her idea of true happiness when a mysterious stranger grants her a Christmas wish for a different life.

title: A Wesley Christmas
description: With all their baggage in tow, adult siblings travel to their childhood home to celebrate Christmas with their parents and the entire family.
